limitations: This author audit covers two already exposed natural base tasks with two correlated repetitions each: 30 reference assessments, 26 correct_decisive and four wrong_decisive against the unchanged frozen references. It is not independent human gold, formal qualification, or evidence of universal construction reliability.

The four wrong assessments share one substantive predicate issue: two Pandoc API prohibitions each narrow the frozen reference in both repetitions. The underlying source relative-clause ambiguity must accompany this count; neither policy is retrospectively credited by changing the reference.

usable denotes a complete source-audit pass under the frozen reference, not mechanical compilation. All four retained artifacts compiled; both download runs pass this audit, while both Pandoc runs do not.

Every assigned run has exactly one retained construction attempt. No provider or constructor was called, and no source, reference, response, graph or compiler was edited. No other audit part was read.

Candidate availability, allowed intervention, single-factor editability, downstream safety and effect estimation were not executed or established. Passing source audit means no confirmed mismatch was found here, not that extraction is universally correct.
